summary: Iter 177 verified all 4 Wave features. Backend (5/5 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter177_discover_prompt_analytics.py): /api/games/sponsor/discover returns seeded Karak Cafe wheel (wheel_spn_02564c15d4) with sponsor_name='Karak Cafe', top_prize, daily_spins=3; house games (wheel_house/scratch_house) correctly excluded. /api/geo/me returns market + detected_market + detected_city (dubai/dfw/Council Bluffs in preview). Sponsor analytics endpoint returns full stats shape (plays/wins/win_rate/unique_players/points_awarded/coupons_won/coupons_redeemed/prize_distribution) for owner and 403 for non-owner (RBAC blocks before ownership check). /api/games/wheel/list still surfaces the seed and /api/games/wheel/config?game_id=... loads with sponsor Karak Cafe (regression PASS). WEB /play-and-win: section-sponsored-instant + sponsor-discover-card-wheel_spn_02564c15d4 + sponsor-discover-play-wheel_spn_02564c15d4 all render correctly for demo@ — HOWEVER the Play button navigates to `/games/spin?game_id=...` which is a NON-EXISTENT ROUTE (React Router logs 'No routes matched location'); the actual defined route in App.js is `/games/wheel` (scratch is `/games/scratch`). This BLOCKS the whole discover → play flow on web. WEB NewCityPrompt (data-testid new-city-prompt) verified across all four states: (a) hidden when detected==applied, (b) shown when detected!=applied, (c) Dismiss (new-city-dismiss) hides it AND persists across reload via localStorage 'fuusic.geoPrompt.dismissed.v1', (d) Switch (new-city-switch) calls PATCH /api/users/me/market with detected_market, updates GeoStore, and hides the banner — verified market flipped from mumbai→dfw. MOBILE: sponsor-discover-rail + sponsor-discover-card-wheel_spn_02564c15d4 render on /games; tapping opens /games/spin?game_id=wheel_spn_02564c15d4 (route EXISTS on mobile) and 'Karak Cafe' appears in DOM; however the rendered wheel visually shows the DEFAULT house segments (5/20/50/100/200 BigCoin + generic 'Sponsor coupon') instead of the sponsor-configured segments — mobile spin screen may not be forwarding game_id to /api/games/wheel/config. NewCityBanner testID new-city-banner was correctly hidden after cleanup (market equals detected). Prize Preview + Analytics modal were NOT UI-tested (merchant portal is gated behind MerchantShell approval flow and iter176 already verified those testIDs — sponsor-preview-toggle/panel/wheel/spin/scratch + sponsor-analytics-modal/stats/distribution — plus the analytics BACKEND is 100% covered in this iteration).

ui_bugs.issue: Navigates to '/games/spin?game_id=...' which is NOT a defined route in App.js (defined route is '/games/wheel'). React Router warns 'No routes matched location' and the wheel does not load. Fix: change PlayAndWin.js:263 to navigate(`/games/${isWheel ? 'wheel' : 'scratch'}?game_id=${g.game_id}`).

When opened with ?game_id=wheel_spn_02564c15d4 (sponsor game), the visual wheel still renders the default house segments (5/20/50/100/200 BigCoin + generic 'Sponsor coupon') instead of the Karak Cafe sponsor-configured segments (500 pts top prize). Sponsor name appears in DOM but the wheel config isn't loading /api/games/wheel/config?game_id=<param>. Verify /app/mobile/app/games/spin.tsx reads useLocalSearchParams().game_id and forwards it to the config request.
